messages:
sylvie: Heads-up — kicking off v2 rollout for /api/generate-stream in eu in ~10m. Deploybot scheduled. Please watch for header-related client errors; this release normalizes `X-Client-Version` casing.

deploybot: Scheduled deployment queued for route `/api/generate-stream` (v2) in region `eu` at 2026-04-12T10:30:00Z. Operator: sylvie. To pause run: `deploybot pause-route --route /api/generate-stream --region eu` :robot_face:

helen: noted. Are we annotating release notes about header case normalization? some mobile SDKs are strict.

sylvie: yes — added a short migration note under BreakingChanges and gave a 48h grace period. Will ping integrations.

nate: quick check — traffic split 5% -> 20% over 30m with linear ramp, right?

sylvie: correct. ramp: 5% -> 20% over 30m. canary groups = mobile + web.

ops-bot: Alert: 2026-04-12T10:35:12Z — 502 spike on /api/generate-stream in eu (20m window) — rate: 18/min (baseline 1/min).

samir: I see new 502s from stream-processor pod group. stack shows header-parsing exception `KeyError: 'x-client-version'` in custom middleware.

helen: mobile SDKs are sending `X-Client-Version` with different case. middleware lowercases headers normally but not this new path?

sylvie: okay — this matches preflight concern. decision time: pause rollout or hotpatch the middleware?

nate: given traffic ramping, pause rollout now and revert to v1 for eu until we either hotpatch or extend header compat. less blast radius.

sylvie: Agreed. pausing via deploybot.

deploybot: Executing: `pause-route --route /api/generate-stream --region eu` by sylvie.

deploybot: Pause successful. Route `/api/generate-stream` in region `eu` pinned to v1 variant. Active traffic now 100% -> v1.

sylvie: rollback decision logged in release playbook. Next steps: 1) short compatibility patch to accept case-insensitive header (Samir) 2) update release notes with explicit header compatibility note (Helen) 3) re-run canary with 1% -> 10% ramp (Nate)

samir: starting hotpatch branch now. quick fix looks like 6 lines in middleware to .lower() header keys before access. I'll open PR and request fast review.

helen: I'll update release notes and send an email to integrators saying we paused eu rollout and will do a reattempt after patching. include SDK snippet: ```js
// safer header access
const v = req.headers['x-client-version'] || req.headers['X-Client-Version'];
```

sylvie: ops checklist: add rollback reason, CI link, impacted tenants list, and schedule reattempt in a quiet window (overnight EU low traffic). I'll mark this as operator handoff.

nate: when PR is green and we have metric baseline stable for 15m, we do a micro-canary 1% for 10m, then 5%, then 20% if stable. rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 1% or latency P95 increase > 50% vs baseline.

samir: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/streaming/merge/1234 — small middleware fix + unit test. cc @helen for docs.

ops-bot: CI: merge/1234 passed all checks.

sylvie: thanks. we'll schedule reattempt in the 02:00-04:00 UTC quiet window. I'll update deploybot schedule once we confirm.

helen: released updated release notes draft and sent integrator email. Pls review: https://confluence/internal/releases/v2-stream-eu

sylvie: thread summary: rollout paused in eu due to header-case KeyError -> paused by deploybot -> pinned back to v1 -> hotpatch PR opened and merged -> reattempt scheduled overnight with strict rollback triggers. will update when deploybot re-schedules. :white_check_mark:
